releases.title: First release
notes: A dash-mounted radar detector with a display modelled on real detectors.
Alerts on Wraith ARS 2X and Seeker Dual DSR radar, ProLaser4 laser, patrol cars and speed cameras.
City, Highway and Auto modes, mute, low-speed muting, K filter and lockouts.
One command, /shrikesettings, for power, settings, move and resize.
QBCore, Qbox, ESX or standalone, in eight languages.
